entities.name: Kuhnde
entities.description: A former Jeskai mantis rider and prospective phoenix rider in the original timeline of Tarkir.

entities.name: Mantis
entities.description: Kuhnde's untameable mount, killed by him to end its misery.

entities.name: Phoenix
entities.description: A creature hidden in a glowing orb that attacked the monastery.

events.summary: Masters of the strongholds test the young Kuhnde and recognize the skills of a mantis rider.
events.quote: they all recognized in him the skill set that was required of being a mantis rider

events.summary: A phoenix in a glowing orb attacks the monastery; Kuhnde's mantis fights it and both crash.
events.quote: the orb revealed itself as a phoenix as it attacked

events.summary: Kuhnde impales his dying mantis to end its misery.
events.quote: he picked up his spear and impaled the mantis's head to end its misery

events.summary: Kuhnde subdues the injured phoenix, striking its beak to control it, resolving to master a new way.
events.quote: He had never learned how to tame a phoenix, but he knew, given the time, he would master a new way.

relations.quote: a prospective phoenix rider of the Jeskai Clan
he picked up his spear and impaled the mantis's head to end its misery
